name: Compliant tower
description: Slender flexible bottom-founded tower with piled foundation and conventional deck, designed for significant lateral deflection in deep water. Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compliant_tower

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Compliant tower: typically 1,500-3,000 ft (450-900 m); Wikipedia Oil platform states 370-910 m

specifications.value: up to 2.5% vs 0.5% for land-based structures

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Compliant tower: uneconomical beyond depths greater than 1,000 m; floating production more appropriate

specifications.value: base 351 ft, 140×140 ft tapering to 90×90 ft, 8,700 t; tower 1,320 ft, 90×90 ft, 20,200 t; storm sway ~30 s period, up to 10 ft lateral
legs up to 144 in diameter / 3.5 in-8 in wall (base); 128 in / 3.3 in-4 in (tower)

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Compliant tower: deepest is Chevron Petronius in 623 m; platform 640 m to flare tip; topsides 7,500 t

specifications.metric: Benguela Belize BBLT base tower launch
specifications.value: base tower first 250 m of >400 m tower; launched from barge H-851 on 15 April 2005; heaviest compliant tower installed; first outside GoM

applications: Slender flexible bottom-founded tower with piled foundation and conventional deck, designed for significant lateral deflection in deep water.
